title: Eleven days
note: EA closed BioWare 21 October. Liquid Swords declared bankrupt in Stockholm 12 October, bids on Samson open until month's end. Getty filed Chapter 11 in Delaware 21 October.

title: What closing BioWare cost
note: EA was taken private for $55bn in August, around $20bn of it reported as borrowed, and has told investors it will find $700m a year in costs. The $20bn and $700m figures are reported, not confirmed by EA.

title: Bids close Saturday
rows: The kerb raised 6cm to stop scraping
note: Samson shipped in April to 28 reviews, mostly negative, with the praise landing almost entirely on the environment art and the driving.

title: A city, end to end
note: Every stage before the last happened inside about thirty people. Only the last one has a legal form.

title: What cannot be auctioned
note: My arithmetic, not Laika's: 131 minutes is about 188,000 exposures at 24fps, divided by Laika's stated throughput. Animator-weeks of shooting, not total production.

text: The file is a photograph of a decision. It does not get you the next one.
